name: ui_hover
description: Softest tick as the mouse passes over a button.
recipe: 3 ms band-passed noise click plus a 2.3 kHz ping, very quiet.

name: ui_press_1
description: Button pressed: a soft woody/brass click.
recipe: Noise click plus damped 680/1550 Hz wood modes and faint inharmonic brass partials, detuned per take.

name: ui_press_2
description: Button pressed: a soft woody/brass click.
recipe: Noise click plus damped 680/1550 Hz wood modes and faint inharmonic brass partials, detuned per take.

name: ui_press_3
description: Button pressed: a soft woody/brass click.
recipe: Noise click plus damped 680/1550 Hz wood modes and faint inharmonic brass partials, detuned per take.

name: ui_release
description: Button released: a lighter, higher click.
recipe: The press recipe pitched up ~22%, shorter and quieter.

name: ui_open
description: Panel opening: a short soft paper/cloth swish.
recipe: Noise through a band-pass sweeping 600 to 2600 Hz under a smooth hump.

name: ui_close
description: Panel closing: a shorter downward swish.
recipe: Noise through a band-pass sweeping 2200 down to 650 Hz, front-weighted.

name: ui_cant
description: Action not possible: two quick dull low thuds.
recipe: Two pitch-dropping low sines (170 to 120 Hz) with low-passed noise puffs, 85 ms apart, low-passed at 1.2 kHz.

name: ui_select
description: Squad member selected: a small bright brass tink.
recipe: Bell-like inharmonic partials on 1.9 kHz (x1, 2.32, 4.07) with a soft attack.

name: ui_order_1
description: Move order given: a soft low thup.
recipe: Sine dropping 190 to 95 Hz plus a low-passed noise puff, detuned per take.

name: ui_order_2
description: Move order given: a soft low thup.
recipe: Sine dropping 190 to 95 Hz plus a low-passed noise puff, detuned per take.

name: ui_order_3
description: Move order given: a soft low thup.
recipe: Sine dropping 190 to 95 Hz plus a low-passed noise puff, detuned per take.

name: talk_open
description: Conversation opens: a very soft breath/rustle.
recipe: Broad noise band sweeping 700 to 1300 Hz plus sparse rustle grains.

name: coins_1
description: Trade screen opens (trade_open): coins clinking onto wood.
recipe: 5-7 coin strikes (4 inharmonic modes each, random pitch) settling faster and quieter, over wooden taps.

name: coins_2
description: Trade screen opens (trade_open): coins clinking onto wood.
recipe: 5-7 coin strikes (4 inharmonic modes each, random pitch) settling faster and quieter, over wooden taps.

name: coins_3
description: Trade screen opens (trade_open): coins clinking onto wood.
recipe: 5-7 coin strikes (4 inharmonic modes each, random pitch) settling faster and quieter, over wooden taps.

name: coin_single
description: One coin set down.
recipe: One coin strike on a wood tap with a small bounce.

name: pack_open
description: Pack opens: leather creak then a buckle clink.
recipe: Friction grains through 380/860/1500 Hz resonators, then a small metal clink.

name: craft_open
description: Crafting opens: tools set on a bench.
recipe: Four metal strikes at different pitches, each with a wooden thump.

name: lid_open
description: Chest lid creaking open.
recipe: Stick-slip pulse train (35 to 90 per second) ringing wooden resonators at 420/950/1700 Hz.

name: lid_close
description: Wooden lid thump shut.
recipe: Low sine thud (120 to 75 Hz), wood modes and a small rattle.

name: take_item_1
description: Picking something up: a soft cloth/leather shuffle.
recipe: Short swept noise band plus rustle grains, timing varied per take.

name: take_item_2
description: Picking something up: a soft cloth/leather shuffle.
recipe: Short swept noise band plus rustle grains, timing varied per take.

name: take_item_3
description: Picking something up: a soft cloth/leather shuffle.
recipe: Short swept noise band plus rustle grains, timing varied per take.

name: page_turn
description: A page turning (journal, spell book).
recipe: Rising noise band with crinkle grains and a soft low flap at the end.

name: step_dirt_1
description: Footstep on earth.
recipe: Heel and toe: low-passed noise thuds with gritty grains on top.

name: step_dirt_2

name: step_stone_1

name: bow_release
description: A bowstring twang.
recipe: Karplus-Strong plucked string at 98 Hz, heavily damped, plus a falling swish and a wood knock.

name: cast
description: A spell starting: a soft rising shimmer.
recipe: Detuned sine partials gliding 420 to 640 Hz with vibrato, light FM and airy rising noise, swelling in.

name: door_open
description: A wooden door: latch, then a creak.
recipe: Two metal latch clicks, then a slow stick-slip creak through 230/560/1150 Hz resonators.

name: knock_down
description: Someone falling: a heavy body thud.
recipe: Sine dropping 72 to 42 Hz with low noise mass, two smaller follow-up impacts and faint gear rattle.

name: fire_loop
description: Quiet crackling fire, seamless 4 s loop.
recipe: Breathing brown-noise roar, faint hiss, random crackles and pops; tail cross-faded into the head.
